structure.unit: Liens of Innkeepers, Livery Stable, Garage and Marina Keepers, Mechanics and Bailees

law.text: Any party may appeal from the judgment of the general district court, as in case of warrants for small claims under Chapter 6 (§ 16.1-76 et seq.) of Title 16.1, and such appeal shall be heard and determined in like manner, as appeals under such chapter.
